create_BaseInfra_config: create a BaseInfra instance and export its task configuration as a ConfDict with uid and exclude_defaults options
build_BaseInfra_uid: build a unique task uid string from a BaseInfra instance using its config and version parameters
test_BaseInfra_clone_obj: test cloning a pydantic model object by applying a diff config to the underlying BaseInfra
review_BaseInfra_uid_folder: review the BaseInfra uid_folder method to get or create the task instance storage folder path
refactor_InfraMethod_check_method_signat: refactor an InfraMethod to validate that its decorated method signature accepts only self as a parameter
